name: Honey Pour
summary: A quantity stepper where a dipper pours real-looking honey into a glass jar as you add weight
about: A product card for a jar of honey sold by weight. Every press of plus tips the dipper and pours a stream into the glass, the syrupy surface ripples and settles, bubbles drift up and the paper label, graduation marks, total and free-delivery bar follow along. At 3 kg the lid drops on and twists shut, and Add to cart packs the jar off into the cart badge with a burst of honeycomb confetti.
how: Press plus or minus to change the jar by 250 g, or tap a quick size such as 1 kg or 3 kg family
Type a weight in kilos (or grams) in the middle box; Enter rounds it to the nearest 250 g
Watch the total and the free-delivery bar; from PKR 10,000 delivery is free
Press Add to cart: the lid goes on, the jar hops into the cart and the badge counts it
